description: Work out what a piece of clothing, a pair of shoes, a bag, jewellery, a watch or an accessory costs at the door when it is shipped to the US, Canada, the UK or Australia: the duty, any extra tariff on the country it was made in, the tax, the government and carrier fees, and the total. Every line names its official source and the day it was read, and the answer links the page on shopwithin.co/duty-calculator that shows it. Use this when a shopper asks about customs, duty, tariffs or import tax on a cross-border order. It is an estimate; the carrier's bill is the final word.

department.description: Women's or men's; some duty rates differ.

kind.description: What the piece is, one of: coat-wool, coat-cotton, coat-polyester, puffer-down, jacket-wool, jacket-cotton, jacket-polyester, jacket-leather, blazer-wool, blazer-cotton, blazer-polyester, trousers-wool, trousers-cotton, trousers-polyester, dress-wool, dress-cotton, dress-silk, dress-polyester, skirt-wool, skirt-cotton, skirt-polyester, shirt-cotton, shirt-silk, shirt-polyester, tshirt-cotton, tshirt-polyester, sweater-cashmere, sweater-wool, sweater-cotton, sweater-polyester, shoes-leather, sneakers-leather, boots-leather, sneakers-textile, bag-leather, bag-textile, wallet-leather, jewellery-gold, jewellery-silver, jewellery-costume, watch-automatic, watch-gold, belt-leather, scarf-silk, scarf-wool, tie-silk, sunglasses.

made_in.description: Two letter country code of where it was made, e.g. IT, FR, CA, US, JP.

region.description: Canada only: the province code, e.g. ON, QC, BC.

ship_by.description: us: fedex, courier or post. canada: fedex, courier or post. uk: royalmail, parcelforce or courier. australia: courier or post.

shipping.description: Optional shipping cost, in the price's currency.

ships_from.description: Two letter country code of where it ships from.

to.description: Where the piece is shipped to.

usmca.description: US only: true if a piece made in Canada or Mexico qualifies under USMCA.

weight_kg.description: Optional weight; a few US lines add a charge per kilogram.

name: estimate_duty
title: Estimate import duty
